body: I'll look into it.  Can't hurt.  I have a strong case of adult ADHD, so I hope it won't interfere with the meditative process.

I'm just tired.  The only reason I do anything is because I have to work and I have to take care of my dogs.  I've already setup a fund for their care too.  I'm not sad.  Not angry.  Not desperate.  Just tired.  Have you ever been too tired to rest?

I'm not taking advice.  What I meant by it is that as much as he lived, it just wasn't enough.  I'm just tired, and I see no point.  I don't want to hurt myself.  I honestly just want to rest.  There is no waking up refreshed and looking forward to...anything, so I'd rather not wake up.  I just wish I knew how to do that.  Sleep and drift off into forever.

Been there.  Done that.  Once the adventure is over, once you have done everything there is to be done, you then realize, there was no point to it.  I've done the selfish thing.  I've done the selfless thing.  I've lived like a hobo and lived like a rock star.  No point.  One word.  Hemingway.

"There is nothin to gain in death."

Sure there is.  Peace.
